packages.headline: Rhapsody in Scarlet announced for PS5

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Discover exhilarating combo-driven action mixing magic and powerful beasts in 1920s New York.
Rhapsody in Scarlet announced for PS5
We’re thrilled to have revealed Rhapsody in Scarlet , a brand-new action game for PlayStation 5, during today’s State of Play and State of Play Japan. Set in the jazz-filled streets of 1920s New York, Rhapsody in Scarlet is an action game where players can enjoy exhilarating combos by wielding magic and beasts. Behind the city’s dazzling skyscrapers and lively streets, an unseen conflict rages among those who practice magic in secret. Players take on the role of Ellie, a young magus who finds herself swept up in events that will shape her destiny.
Many action games nowadays focus on weapon-based close-quarters combat, but with Rhapsody in Scarlet, we wanted to create something different, allowing players to build highly customizable combos and harness the unique possibilities of magic.
One of the defining features of Rhapsody in Scarlet is its dynamic action, which sees Ellie wield magic while commanding beast companions in battle. The stylish combat blends close- and long-range attacks, area-of-effect spells, and beast techniques into highly customizable combos. Finding combos that fit your playstyle and adapting them to different enemies and situations is one of the game’s core appeals.
In addition to its exhilarating action, Rhapsody in Scarlet also places a strong emphasis on its story, woven together by a cast of distinctive characters. For more, please take a look at the story trailer revealed during State of Play Japan: 
In Rhapsody in Scarlet, we have worked to recreate the atmosphere of 1920s New York as much as possible, from its architecture and fashion to its cars and Prohibition-era speakeasies. The 1920s were a time of remarkable energy and change, marked by the rapid spread of automobiles and radios, as well as the growing presence of women in society. To faithfully recreate the vibrant atmosphere of New York during this era, we carried out on-site research and gathered a wide range of historical references. At the same time, we introduced fantasy elements such as Beasts, magic, and the magical district they inhabit, creating a distinctive world where historical reality and fantasy come together as one. By incorporating jazz inspired by the sounds of the 1920s, we have also created a unique experience, where swing-filled sound and action come together as one.
Exhilarating action powered by magic and beasts, a distinctive world set in 1920s New York, and a story centered on Ellie and Ilya await in Rhapsody in Scarlet.

packages.headline: Final Fantasy Resonance PS5 demo available today, Sephiroth revealed

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Experience the entire first chapter and carry your save data over to the full game.
Final Fantasy Resonance PS5 demo available today, Sephiroth revealed
Today’s State of Play featured a new look at Final Fantasy Resonance , launching October 22, 2026. We’re also excited to announce the release of a free demo for PlayStation 5 , featuring the entire first chapter of the game. Save data from the demo can be carried over to the full game.
Final Fantasy Resonance is built on the concept, “What if Final Fantasy had continued to push the limits of pixel art?” The game sends you off on a journey to protect the Crystals scattered across the world and to stop the pursuit of Veritas of the Dark who seeks to destroy the world. This tale of crystals is brought to life in high-definition pixel art in the HD-2D style, alongside familiar Final Fantasy elements such as chocobos and airships, an evolved turn-based battle system, and a more accessible take on the classic job system.
Final Fantasy’s classic turn-based command battles have evolved to deliver greater accessibility and deeper strategy.
Once an ability is learned from a vision, it can still be equipped even when a different vision is active, as long as it remains within the cost limit, allowing abilities from multiple visions to be set at the same time. This system is a more accessible and evolved take on the familiar job system from the FINAL FANTASY series, with certain ability setups producing powerful synergies.
Visit vision crystal sanctums scattered across the world to obtain visions of legacy Final Fantasy heroes. Equip them as you would any other vision to harness their powers.
The latest trailer released during today’s State of Play revealed that Sephiroth will be making an appearance. Players will be able to find and challenge Sephiroth in hopes of winning and unlocking a special reward.
When a Sweeping Stagger occurs, you can unleash a Vision-specific special move called “Resonance” at the end of the Extra Phase. Resonances come in many forms—not only delivering high damage but also offering a variety of abilities such as powerful AoE attacks and additional effects.
The opening movie and other cinematics feature a cutting-edge pixel-based style using a production method that renders 3DCG in pixel form to achieve dynamic visuals while retaining the timeless charm of pixel art.

packages.headline: Fate/Extra Record launches Jan 28 2027 on PS5 & PS4

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Discover the Holy Grail War and revamped battle system in this full remake of Fate/Extra.
Fate/Extra Record launches Jan 28 2027 on PS5 & PS4
During today’s State of Play, we announced that Fate/Extra Record , developed by Type-Moon, will be releasing worldwide on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 on January 28, 2027!
We know everyone’s been patiently waiting to learn more about this return to the Fate universe, so we’ve shared a thrilling new trailer jam-packed with the latest footage detailing this fresh telling of the “Moon Holy Grail War.”
The Fate series began with Type-Moon’s PC game Fate/stay night, released in 2004. Since then, the franchise has expanded beyond games across a wide range of media, including manga adaptations, novelizations, and anime. At the heart of the series is a modern battle fantasy, where legendary heroes from the past, known as Servants, are summoned by Masters to fight for the Holy Grail, an all-powerful artifact said to grant any wish. Together, Masters and Servants enter a deadly conflict where they must battle until only one remains. As of August 2026, the Fate series spans more than 100 titles across games, anime, novels, manga, apps, and other media.
Originally released in Japan in July 2010, Fate/Extra was the series’ first RPG. Fate/Extra Record revisits this pivotal entry in the Fate franchise, completely rebuilding it for modern platforms. Not only has the story been expanded, character graphics have been renewed, and the presentation has been updated for the modern era, but a new strategic deck-building Command Card battle system has been introduced to elevate the gameplay, too. We believe this makes Fate/Extra Record accessible and easy to play for newcomers, while offering a fresh experience for fans of the original game.
Fate/Extra Record’s battle system has been completely overhauled from the original game. Now, combat plays out through the use of customizable decks in Command Card Battles. It’s up to you to build your deck with a variety of different Commands, bringing an added layer of strategy to each encounter.
Along with standard digital editions on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5, we’ll also have a Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes the Fate/Extra Record digital edition, numerous cosmetic costumes, an in-game arranged music pack from the original Fate/Extra, and the digital versions of the art book and soundtrack that are included in the physical Limited Edition.

packages.headline: From 4X to 4R: BioEden Trades Domination for Restoration

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
BioEden, a cozy management game launching today, takes the genre's familiar structure and points it toward not conquest, but restoration.
From 4X to 4R: BioEden Trades Domination for Restoration
What if a 4X game's real enemy wasn't a rival empire, but pollution? BioEden, a cozy management game from Broken Arms Games, launching today, takes the genre's familiar structure and points it somewhere new: not toward conquest, but toward restoration.
BioEden is set in a post-apocalyptic future shaped by solarpunk ideals, a speculative movement imagining a hopeful world powered by renewable energy and ecological balance.
It’s a formula built on acquisition and dominance. BioEden ‘s developers looked elsewhere for inspiration, toward cozy, environmentally minded management games like Terra Nil , The Wandering Village , and Timberborn , all of which center the player’s relationship with nature rather than rivalry. So instead of the 4X, BioEden builds its identity around the 4R: Restore, Relax, Revive, Recycle. Yves Hohler, CEO and Creative Director at Broken Arms Games, puts it simply: “ BioEden isn’t about conquering a world. It’s about helping it heal, because every world deserves a second chance. We wanted to make a game where restoring nature is more rewarding than exploiting it.” 
The 4X’s structural bones are still there, just aimed differently. Classic 4X games usually start players off with a blank slate (no research, no technology, no culture) so that every civilization builds itself up from nothing. BioEden borrows this framework loosely: rather than a tech tree built for territorial gain, players progress through story beats, choices, and requests that earn trust with their guild, unlocking new buildings and upgrades along the way.
Diplomacy gets the same twist. In most 4X games, diplomacy plays out between rival players or AI-controlled empires, ranging from friendly to openly hostile. In BioEden , there’s only one relationship that matters: the one between the player and the planet itself. How the world responds is shaped entirely by the player’s choices and playstyle.
BioEden ‘s core tension comes from a simple rule: everything you build has an environmental cost. Every device or structure is artificial, built from consumed resources, and it pollutes the planet simply by existing. Most buildings also need electricity and sometimes water, which means the player has to generate energy to keep them running, and physically connect each structure to its power source, either directly or via power poles. One building can quickly become three, and what looked like a harmless little structure can spiral into a real pollution problem.
That could easily tip BioEden toward stress and survival rather than the relaxation the 4R promises. Recycling is the game’s answer. In most 4X games, demolishing a building returns a fraction of its resources, if you’re lucky, and the loss is usually final. In BioEden , recycling returns everything you put in and undoes the pollution it caused, reinforcing the game’s central premise: this is a planet that can always be healed.
A genre built for a post-capitalist world
Humanity has expanded into space, and colonization is now overseen by the Collective, a political assembly made up of rival space-faring guilds. Earth itself has become inhospitable, and most animal species are extinct. The Collective’s mission is to coordinate the guilds’ efforts to revive the life that’s been lost, whether the cause was climate collapse or the civilizations that once called these worlds home. To the Collective, the reason doesn’t matter. Only recovery does.

packages.headline: Hunter’s Moon, an immersive historical folk-horror, launches October 26 on PS5

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Flee under the Hunter’s Moon as an accused “witch” on the run for her life
Hunter’s Moon, an immersive historical folk-horror, launches October 26 on PS5
We are thrilled to finally announce Hunter’s Moon – a first-person historical narrative folk-horror game coming exclusively to PlayStation 5 on October 26* – the night of the full Hunter’s Moon.
Hunter’s Moon is set over the course of one fateful night. Meet mummers dressed in folk costumes, evade capture by the witch hunters, and eavesdrop on a characterful cast of regular folk worn down by war and misfortune. Discover the secrets of this dysfunctional village on the brink as you embody an accused “witch” on the run for her life.
You play as Lilith Thorne, an accused woman who must flee through a 17th–century rural village and its surrounding forests and moors in search of safety. As she is stalked and hunted by the Witchfinder General, the village magistrate, and a local huntsman, you must use stealth and cunning to evade capture. And by eavesdropping at windows, you may gain knowledge and aid that can help her survive the night – warning words, sage counsel, sacred items, or perchance a folk song.
The game features a novel immersive-theatre-inspired eavesdropping mechanic that invites the player to explore and discover this early modern village and its stories – grounded in historical realism, elevated by handcrafted stylised art, and told through the voices of over 100 fully voice-acted characters.
In 1644, Matthew Hopkins began his crusade of witch hunting in England, styling himself “the Witchfinder General.” In 1647, he published a book, The Discovery of Witches, which comprised a series of questions and answers in which he justified his controversial methods for identifying witches. Arguably the most notorious witch hunter in history, Matthew Hopkins and his colleague John Stearne sent more to the gallows for witchcraft than all other English witch hunters before them.
In 2019, I began writing a screenplay inspired by this history while working as a producer at Crows Crows Crows. Transforming this vision to the screen led me to found the new independent studio Twin Swans, bringing together talented artists and developers whose credits also include The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe, The Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and Signalis. Our shared love of history and craft guided us in the creation of Hunter’s Moon – a reimagining of a witch hunt in 17th-century Early Modern England offering an experience of the stories and horrors that might unfold under such wicked circumstances.

packages.headline: JOIN US Continues Indoctrinating Us with a Good Time

Have you heard the good and noble word of our Leader? I’d be happy to tell you all about him if you happen to have a few minutes. Or hours. Days? The rest of your life? Honestly, it’ll be fun. Why don’t you put on these robes and Join Us in our little sandbox of adventure?
JOIN US Continues Indoctrinating Us with a Good Time
Have you heard the good and noble word of our Leader? I’d be happy to tell you all about him if you happen to have a few minutes. Or hours. Days? The rest of your life? Honestly, it’ll be fun. Why don’t you put on these robes and JOIN US in our little sandbox of adventure?
See, we’re a fun little commune known as The Infants of Sheep – not a cult, I want to make that clear; we’re a family – that wants to make the world a better place. How do we grow our flock?  We do that by meeting all sorts of new and wonderful people walking around town – if they have a few seconds to chat, chances are my silver tongue can bring them to our side. And you would be correct to assume that it was one of our flyers you spotted in town. That helps spread our loving word even further, bringing more wonderful people to our little family in the corner of this wide-open rural corner of America – it’s funny, at times it really does feel like I could go anywhere I set my eye on.
I’m thinking we will start with a couple of tents, a few beds, a campfire for cooking and a propaganda station (we need to get some more flyers up around town to build our numbers). The line always must go up, am I right?! We’ll hit the town later and look for supplies to bring back – we’ll need these if we want to build more structures and tools.
Also, the Leader is much more communicative with us now over the radio, guiding us along the way to make sure we understand the ins and outs of our living situation before setting us loose in the world. Our glorious fax machine inside the compound is how he keeps us focused and moving with objectives and goals.
Let’s step back outside. That over there with the benches and the scribbling on the wall is our little area for Teachings. This collection of beliefs allows us to select an ideology that makes our experience in the world unique and offers creative ways for us to grow our flock – like hitting non-believers over the head with a baseball bat to convert them.
Another thing I appreciate about our little slice of the world is the abundance of vehicles for the taking and they each handle a little differently. I’m thinking we will ditch the camper van for that pick-up truck on the side of the road for our drive back home. No, that isn’t stealing. They are more than welcome to come take it back when I’m done with it. Also, when you get a chance, see if you can’t find yourself a little golf cart to drive around town.
For now, I’m going to swap bodies. Yeah, it’s a thing we do. If I start to feel tired or hungry, I can just move freely into any of our fellow members no matter where they are in the world – the more members, the more body swapping. You should try it sometime.
What’s that? Oh, yes. That’s indeed a weapon cache. Feel free to break it open and build yourself an arsenal, I’m not picky. You can grab pistols, machetes, or even an AK-47. You can’t be too careful around these parts; people can be… resistant to our charms!
The timing of your arrival couldn’t have been more perfect as we’ve really been working hard to spruce up the place – you should have seen it a few months ago . We have so many more things available to us to help build out our commune, and we can place things pretty much wherever we want.

packages.headline: Onimusha: Way of the Sword – The Many Means of Mastery

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Onimusha's swordfighting is some of the best we've played - here are some of the many ways to turn a fight in your favor.
Onimusha: Way of the Sword – The Many Means of Mastery
I’ve been lucky enough to play through Onimusha: Way of the Sword ahead of launch and, among its incredible boss fights and fabulously grimdark story, one thing shines through above all else – for me, this is about as good as swordfighting has ever felt in a game.
In part, that’s down to animation – Miyamoto Musashi feels alive in your hands, able to seamlessly and beautifully move from attacks to parries and back again, even in fights against multiple enemies. But it’s also down to the number of options at your disposal at any given time – within the first couple of hours, Way of the Sword lives up to its name by giving you multiple ways to tackle anything from a lowly Genma footsoldier, up to the cruellest multi-stage boss.
Most unusually, it’s in how it makes defending from attacks feel not only fun, but vital, a means of turning any moment on the back foot into an opportunity to end the fight in a few strokes. To give you a sense of how much you have to work with, here are the many ways you can deal with opponents and take control.
If you’ve played most modern action games, you’ll know how to parry – hit block just as an attack lands, and Musashi will sweep it away, usually leaving an enemy defenceless for a few precious seconds. Way of the Sword further incentivises parrying with the Blaze Gauge – parry enough attacks and you’ll enter Blazing State, which can result in more health and stamina damage, nets you extra souls, and looks extremely cool.
Oh, you want another way to parry? Try Deflect – rather than a standard parry, this involves blocking and hitting A as an attack lands instead. A deflection won’t break an enemy’s stance, but it does a huge amount of stamina damage (even more if you’re in the Blazing State as you do so), eventually letting you perform a Break Issen – a special attack that kills most weak enemies and can cut down bosses far faster. As an added bonus, Deflections can send enemy projectiles back at whoever fired it towards you.
Your ultimate risk-reward ability, Issen involves starting an attack in the precise moment just before an enemy lands their blow – with an even smaller window for success than a regular parry. When you pull it off, Musashi effectively teleports to the side and lands one of his most powerful blows. It looks incredible, but you’ll need to master the timing to get it right consistently.
Barrages and Locks are rarer events with major potential upsides. If you land an attack at the exact same time as an enemy, you’ll enter a Barrage – effectively a mini-duel. Your job is to pay attention to what you were doing just a second before – if you entered the Barrage with a light attack on X, hit the heavy attack on Y to dodge the enemy and land a heavy blow (and if you entered with heavy, hit light).
Your first line of defence should usually be your last resort. Holding LB lets Musashi block most attacks (including ranged) from any angle, but every hit costs you stamina – run out and you’ll lose your stance and a healthy chunk of souls (particularly galling when you’ve been patiently building up a special attack gauge). Whenever possible, you should be aiming to do something else from this list.

From Graceful Decay and Annapurna, the teams behind recursive puzzle game Maquette.
Uncover the secrets of Uncanyon, a new PS5 adventure game coming 2027
Hi everyone, it’s great to be back on the PlayStation.Blog. It’s been a few years since we shared Maquette with you, and while that game was about the shifting scale of perspective and memories, we’ve spent our time since then thinking about a different kind of shift: the shift of unparallel realities.
Today, we’re excited to give you a first glimpse of what we’ve been building. This is Uncanyon .
A bew take on classic adventures
Uncanyon is a puzzle-first adventure set in a forgotten world that emerged and once flourished in the folds of converging unparallel universes. You play as Sonia, a stranger to this land. As she explores, she’ll start piecing together not just how to survive Uncanyon, but why it needs her (whether she’s ready for that role or not).
While Sonia is trying to save the world in classic adventure tradition, her story is also a personal one.  Although she arrived in Uncanyon looking for excitement, as Sonia becomes aware of her fate and her role, the weight of being a hero expected to save the world starts to weigh heavily on her.  
For that, our team looked to our own lives, drawing from the pressure of family expectations and the invisible obligations social media places on so many of us. She’s someone handling these pressures in real time, the same way we all are, and that shared uncertainty is something we leaned into throughout the writing and world design.

Once the deal is closed, Merge Mansion will officially become part of Supercell's live games portfolio.
Supercell, the company known for the likes of Clash Royale and Brawl Stars , has signed a deal to acquire Merge Mansion developer Metacore.
According to comments from Metacore in May, its restructure and resulting acquisition by Supercell aims to "better align with the core business, improve efficiency of operations, and respond to an increasingly competitive market environment." This comes at a time where Merge Mansion 's growth has "plateaued over the past few years" since its 2020 launch, as well when new investments have not succeeded in launching new games globally.
Once the deal is closed, Merge Mansion will officially become part of Supercell's live games portfolio. In the meantime, both companies are already working to plan the transition of the game.
"As we move into this next phase together with Supercell, I'm excited about the opportunities this creates for the game, our team and our players," Metacore CEO Mika Tammenkoski says in this week's announcement . "Supercell's expertise in operating and growing global live games over many years gives Merge Mansion the best possible foundation for long-term success."
Supercell, which sits under the Tencent umbrella, has spent the last couple of years buying majority stakes in and acquiring studios . In 2022, Supercell also ended development on two of its projects: Clash Quest and Everdale .
The acquisition, which is expected to be completed at the end of September, is the latest example of major restructurings in the mobile game space. sources.label: GameRant Gaming
sources.evidenceText:
Black Clover season 2 finally has a release date, and it's coming soon to streaming services.
Black Clover Season 2 Release Date Officially Announced
Black Clover was once one of the best new-gen anime series around, being regarded as one of the hottest 2010s series for Weekly Shonen Jump. Black Clover's anime, which initially debuted in 2017, found great success immediately. However, as fans know, this series has been on hiatus since 2021, largely due to Yuki Tabata's health slowing down the manga, which in turn meant that Studio Pierrot did not have enough content to continue the anime.
Now with the manga over, the studio has room to bring Asta's story to completion. Black Clover Season 2 was announced at Anime Expo 2025. On September 3, 2026, Studio Pierrot and Shueisha officially announced the release date for Black Clover Season 2. It's now been confirmed that the series is premiering on October 3, 2026, and we're all eager to see what Studio Pierrot has in store for us.
Black Clover Season 2 Confirms October 3 Release Date
Black Clover is undoubtedly one of the most popular magical action shonen series. Since its debut, it has enjoyed quite a remarkable run. Sadly, on March 30, 2021, Black Clover released what would be its final episode for quite some time. Black Clover Episode 170 was followed by a big hiatus. It's been 5 long and excruciating years since this break, and a lot has changed. Previously, the slow manga progression by Yuki Tabata led to the anime slowing down as well. But the anime can now continue and finish the story, as the manga finally concluded on May 1, 2026, in Jump GIGA’s 2026 Spring Edition with Chapter 392.
Fans have been eager for Black Clover's return ever since the initial announcement of the new anime season in July 2025 at Anime Expo. On June 14, 2026, we received a new update for Black Clover Season 2, and it was confirmed that the series would be coming to broadcast and streaming services in October 2026. However, until today, we did not know exactly when Black Clover would be airing. With that being said, on September 3, 2026, it was officially announced that Black Clover season 2 Episode 1 will be airing on October 3, 2026. After a long wait, Black Clover's new episodes are finally ahead of us.
For fans who don't want to wait until October, there is a chance to see the first episode slightly earlier. On September 21, 2026, Crunchyroll will hold an Anime Night Event in theaters across North America, which allows a limited number of fans to view the first episode of Black Clover Season 2 , previously also seen during Black Clover’s Stage at Anime Expo 2026. We also have official confirmation of the opening and ending songs that will be included for Black Clover's new installment. The opening is a song titled ‘Kienai Riyuu’ by WANIMA, and the ending is ‘One or Eight’ by Yellow Brick Road.
Black Clover's anime is completely changing upon its return. When Black Clover first debuted on October 3, 2017, all the way until it went on hiatus on March 30, 2021, the anime followed a weekly release pattern. We received new episodes on a weekly basis that often featured subpar animation as well as bad pacing. This naturally brought the overall quality of the series down greatly. Even with 170 episodes, the anime of Black Clover is still not even done with its previously ongoing Spade Kingdom Raid arc.

packages.headline: 'We Were All Positive It Was Going to Fail': Rockstar Devs Thought GTA Online Would Flop

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
A former Rockstar Games developer has revealed that the team thought GTA Online was going to fail before it launched.
'We Were All Positive It Was Going to Fail': Rockstar Devs Thought GTA Online Would Flop
In an interview with Eldorado , ex-Rockstar Games developer Matt Freedman looked back on the success of GTA 5 and attributed a lot of it to GTA Online. He noted that a lot of investors seek a GTA Online-level success nowadays, but said it was treated as an "afterthought" during its initial development.
"When we were working on GTA Online, it was an afterthought," said Freedman. "We were all positive it was going to fail. Everyone thought this thing was going to fail. I remember QA testers coming up to me [and saying], 'We’ve got four hours of content for online mode. To do everything in GTA Online, it’s four hours,' or it was something like that. It was really short, and they’re like: ‘We are in so much trouble,' and we’re all sitting there going, 'Let’s see what happens. We’re going to do our best job anyways.' And then it took off, and then there was, to Rockstar’s credit, a fast follow with as much content as possible and [it] just kind of keep it going. And now it’s become this phenomenon."
It's unclear when the perception of GTA Online's potential began to shift at Rockstar. The studio did seem to have ambitions for it before launch, as it released a sizable trailer and media previews for the online mode before the game's release with plans for post-launch content like heists. Still, Freedman is right that the game was pretty light on content upon arrival. There wasn't a ton to do beyond the typical sandbox mayhem and the most exciting content in the game didn't arrive until years later, including its heists update.
Still, Rockstar worked hard to support it, even if its success did seem to catch the company off-guard. Rockstar Games had plans for GTA 5 single player DLC, which was scrapped after GTA Online took off and required more resources. It also reportedly wasn't feasible to do both while also developing Red Dead Redemption 2, so Rockstar leaned into GTA Online.
It's also hard to imagine that the studio anticipated GTA Online running for as long as it has. 13 years later, GTA Online is still getting massive updates and despite GTA 6's release on the horizon, the team may well keep supporting it while it keeps being profitable. GTA 6 will be a "single player experience" when it launches and Rockstar has been cagey about its plans for online beyond that. It also just announced its official nopixel RP server for the PC version of GTA 5 , which shows a pretty high level of commitment.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
任天堂は9月4日、『マリオストーリー』のサウンドトラックを音楽アプリ「Nintendo Music」にて配信開始した。
“10万円級”の高額プレミア『マリオストーリー』サントラがNintendo Musicに到来。CD版を大幅に上回る「全148曲」収録、たっぷり聴き放題
任天堂は9月4日、『 マリオストーリー 』のサウンドトラックを音楽アプリ「Nintendo Music」にて配信開始した。Nintendo Musicは、Nintendo Switch Online加入者向けサービスだ。
『マリオストーリー』は、2000年にNINTENDO 64向けに発売されたアクションRPGだ。本作では夜空のはるかかなたにある星の国にて、7人の星の精たちに守られていた「スターのつえ」が大魔王クッパに奪われてしまう。マリオはクッパに捕まった星の精とピーチ姫を救い出すべく、仕掛け満載のフィールドで冒険を繰り広げていく。
なお『マリオストーリー』のオリジナルサウンドトラックは2000年の発売後、廃盤となってから収録楽曲がほかのサウンドトラックに収録されたことがなかった。中古販売では非常に高額なプレミア価格となっており、5万円～10万円での出品も散見される状況であった。ちなみに本稿執筆時点での Amazon.co.jp での出品額は約17万円となっている。
そんなオリジナルサウンドトラックに収録されていたのは78曲のみ。今回の「Nintendo Music」での配信では先述したとおり倍近くの楽曲が収録されており、本作の各BGM堪能することができるだろう。ちなみに『マリオストーリー』はNintendo Switch Online ＋ 追加パック加入者向けの「NINTENDO 64 Nintendo Classics」で配信中。楽曲を聴いて久しぶりにゲームを遊びたくなった人は、同サービスでゲーム本編もプレイしてみるといいかもしれない。
このたびはそんな本作のサウンドトラックが「Nintendo Music」にて配信開始。全148曲、4時間29分におよぶ楽曲を余さず聴くことができる。楽曲によっては同アプリのながさチェンジ機能にも対応している。

“死亡診断書作成”で真相に迫るミステリー『フレミング邸の殺人事件』11月3日リリースへ。「死因調査」からじっくり考察、連続殺人事件の真相に迫る
デベロッパーのSUPERTHUMbは9月3日、ミステリーアドベンチャーゲーム『 フレミング邸の殺人事件 』の発売日が11月3日に決定したことを発表した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）で、ゲーム内の日本語表示にも対応する。
『フレミング邸の殺人事件』は、1959年のイングランドを舞台とした法医学ミステリーアドベンチャーゲームだ。プレイヤーはロンドン郊外のカントリーハウス、フレミング邸で相次いで発生している原因不明の死について調査し、真相を追及していくことになる。
『フレミング邸の殺人事件』はPC（ Steam ）で11月3日に発売予定。同プラットフォームでは、プロローグと第1章が遊べるデモ版が配信中だ。
本作の各事件は、現場を調べるところからスタートする。遺体の状態を確認し、周囲を調べ、関係者から話を聞き、見つけた証拠から事件の全体像を組み立てるというのが基本的な流れとなっている。現場での調査ではまず、遺体のほか部屋や残された物品などから物的証拠を捜索。不審死した人たちの死因を調べ、事故、自殺、殺人のどれが原因で死に至ったかを推理する。邸宅の住人や各事件に関わる人物からの聞き込みも重要になるが、人によっては正直に情報提供をしてくれない場合もある。

packages.headline: 『Escape from Tarkov』生みの親が携わる新作FPS『Fragmentary Order』、ゲームプレイ映像を今月中に本格公開へ。謎多き“未来タルコフ”、いよいよ全貌に迫る

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
Rant Gaming Studiosは9月4日、『Fragmentary Order』の公式トレイラーを公開した。
『Escape from Tarkov』生みの親が携わる新作FPS『Fragmentary Order』、ゲームプレイ映像を今月中に本格公開へ。謎多き“未来タルコフ”、いよいよ全貌に迫る
本作については、今年2月に「Cor3」として発表されたタイトルだ。『Escape from Tarkov』の開発元として知られるBattlestate Gamesの代表Nikita Buyanov氏が開発に携わる一方で、本作がBattlestate Gamesとは無関係であることも説明された。そして4月には『Fragmentary Order』の作品名で正式発表。公式サイトの情報からは、「一瞬ですべてを失う」ことがあるほか、スタッシュやレイド外施設を構築する要素も存在することも判明し、『Escape from Tarkov』に似たゲームプレイとなる可能性についても考察されてきた（ 関連記事 ）。
『Escape from Tarkov』開発元、なんとパブリッシング事業に参入へ。『タルコフ』のように“○○すぎ”な尖りゲームを支援する
Rant Gaming Studiosは9月4日、『 Fragmentary Order 』の公式トレイラーを公開した。その中では、本作のゲームプレイ映像を9月中に公開することも明かされている
『Fragmentary Order』は、2251年の未来を舞台とするハードコアSFFPSだ。本作の世界ではかつて「CORE」という組織が滅びかけた人類を導き、飢餓と戦争をなくし、太陽系の探索に乗り出させた。宇宙進出のなかで、次第に人々の各国政府への信頼は失墜し、COREによって管理される企業主導の権力体制へと移行。しかし、太陽系探査や火星への入植が進むにつれてCOREの支配力が弱まり、新たな同盟が台頭。人類は再び争いの時代に突入することになる。

packages.headline: 『Escape from Tarkov』開発元、なんとパブリッシング事業に参入へ。『タルコフ』のように“○○すぎ”な尖りゲームを支援する

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
Battestate Gamesは9月4日、パブリッシング部門「Battlestate Games Publishing」の設立を発表した。
『Escape from Tarkov』開発元、なんとパブリッシング事業に参入へ。『タルコフ』のように“○○すぎ”な尖りゲームを支援する
Battlestate GamesはハードコアFPS『Escape from Tarkov』の開発元として知られるデベロッパーだ。Nikita Buyanov氏が代表を務めている。同作は約10年間にわたるベータテスト期間を経て、昨年11月に正式リリース。その後もシーズン制の導入をはじめ、アップデートを継続している。
同社は今回の発表にともない、パブリッシング事業に参入する意図を説明。誰もが「やりすぎ」「遅すぎ」「厳しすぎ」「奇抜すぎ」と却下してきたアイデアから『Escape from Tarkov』を作り上げたとしている。そして今度は、同じようなことを他の人たちのゲームでしたいとのこと。
そのため、あらゆるパブリッシャーが見送るようなハードコアなプロジェクト、すなわちニッチすぎたり、残虐すぎたり、硬派すぎたり、万人受けしなさすぎたりするような作品を持っているなら、ぜひ送ってきてほしいと呼びかけている。なおジャンルは問わないとのことで、『Escape from Tarkov』のようなFPSに限らないようだ。同社が求めているのは無難な企画ではなく、投資家を不安にさせたような企画なのだという。磨かれた必要はなく、信念だけがあればいいとして、尖った作品を積極的に募る姿勢を見せた。
Battlestate Games is opening its doors to publishing. We built Tarkov on ideas everyone else said were too much, too slow, too punishing, too weird. Turns out "too much" was the point. Now we want to do that for other people's games. If you've got a hardcore project that every… pic.twitter.com/stSUZb9GPQ
なお同社が手がける『Escape from Tarkov』については先週にも、12月のシーズン2のローンチに向けた ロードマップを公開 するなど、今後も開発を継続する姿勢を見せている。その傍らで、他の作品のパブリッシングにもリソースを注いでいくのだろう。
『Escape from Tarkov』生みの親が携わる新作FPS『Fragmentary Order』、ゲームプレイ映像を今月中に本格公開へ。謎多き“未来タルコフ”、いよいよ全貌に迫る
Battestate Gamesは9月4日、パブリッシング部門「Battlestate Games Publishing」の設立を発表した。あわせて、同社がパブリッシングをおこなうプロジェクトの募集を開始している。
